description: Source code for an Android hardware lights module, managing backlight brightness via sysfs interface and providing functions for light control.

methods.name: write_int
methods.description: Writes an integer value to a specified sysfs path, handling errors and warnings.

methods.name: rgb_to_brightness
methods.description: Converts a color value from light_state_t to a brightness level based on RGB components.

methods.name: set_light_backlight
methods.description: Sets the backlight brightness based on the provided light_state_t.

methods.name: close_lights
methods.description: Closes the light device, freeing resources.

methods.name: open_lights
methods.description: Initializes and opens the light device for a given light type.
